measurement.age: years; exact source rounding not established
measurement.gender: binary male/female membership described; original numeric coding unresolved
measurement.FPG: fresh fasting plasma, hexokinase/G6PD, mmol/L; fasting hours unreported

source_metadata.population: Six Shanghai communities, 2007-2008; excludes previously diagnosed diabetes and specified medical, questionnaire and age exclusions, retaining screen-detected diabetes. Explicit exclusion under age 20 differs from prose over age 20; exact boundary unresolved.

measurement.FPG: fasting venous plasma, glucose oxidase, mmol/L; stated 10-hour fast
measurement.HbA1c_percent: HPLC, percent; printed Tosoh instrument HLC-73G7 retained without correction

source_metadata.source_preprocessing: Correlation-specific missing handling and quantile algorithm not reported.

source_metadata.population: Selected 2019 rural Yanlou/Shandong follow-up, age 61-80, free of dementia and functional disability; known diabetes included. Demographics/BMI collected in 2018, laboratory measurements in 2019.

measurement.age: years; source timing retained as reported
measurement.FSG: serum, glucose oxidase CS-600B, mmol/L, local laboratory within two hours
measurement.HbA1c_percent: EDTA whole blood, HPLC Huizhong MQ6000, percent, KingMed within two days
measurement.FPG_distinction: Separate plasma hexokinase measurement; never alias it to FSG.

common_interpretation.source_population: Each record belongs to its named source analysis population and measurement context. Do not pool different sources as a single empirical cohort or assume they describe the requested target.
common_interpretation.marginal_information: Source margins do not identify predictor dependence, conditional response, tails or transport. Additional modelling choices must be declared assumptions.
common_interpretation.individual_dispersion: Reported individual SDs are not estimator SEs. Their divisor is unreported where marked; no estimator precision may be manufactured from them or synthetic sample size.
common_interpretation.quantiles: Q1 and Q3 are quartile endpoints, not confidence intervals or SDs. The original interpolation algorithm is unknown where marked.
common_interpretation.counts: Count fractions are derived from stated numerator and denominator and are not verified weighted population proportions. Preserve the named category independently of its chosen numeric encoding.
common_interpretation.units: Keep HbA1c IFCC mmol/mol and HbA1c percent distinct. Keep fasting plasma FPG and fasting serum FSG distinct. No unit conversion, assay equivalence or universal serum-to-plasma correction is installed here.
common_interpretation.unknowns: Original unreported weights, processing, sample-specific counts and uncertainty remain unreported. A declared modelling assumption must not be relabelled as a reported source fact.
common_interpretation.source_role_approval: Source metadata and marginal roles were reviewed as source-context information, not target calibration or proof of transport.
